# Ramani Steel House — grade data

> Standard limits and minimum properties for the grades Ramani Steel House supplies from
> Mumbai, India. Same figures as the grade pages, in one file.
> Page content last updated 2026-10-14. Full site map: https://www.ramanisteel.com/llms.txt

## How to read this data

- Chemistry limits and mechanical minimums are those published in the ASTM
  standard named for each grade. They describe the standard, not any heat we
  have supplied; the chemistry and properties of material supplied are reported
  on its mill test certificate.
- Where a designation, standard or property is not confirmed, it is omitted.
- Availability, sizes and price are confirmed on enquiry: https://www.ramanisteel.com/request-quote/

## Duplex 2205 (S31803)

- Page: https://www.ramanisteel.com/products/duplex-super-duplex/duplex-2205/
- UNS: S31803; Werkstoff Nr. 1.4462
- Type: Duplex stainless
- Density: 7.8 g/cm³
- Standard basis: ASTM A240
- Minimum properties (Annealed): tensile 620 MPa, yield 450 MPa, elongation 25%
- Chemistry limits (weight %): Carbon (C) 0.030; Manganese (Mn) 2.00; Phosphorus (P) 0.030; Sulphur (S) 0.020; Silicon (Si) 1.00; Chromium (Cr) 21.0 – 23.0; Nickel (Ni) 4.5 – 6.5; Molybdenum (Mo) 2.5 – 3.5; Nitrogen (N) 0.08 – 0.20; Iron (Fe) Balance
- Applications: Chemical processing; Oil & gas; Pulp & paper; Structural

## Hastelloy C276

- Page: https://www.ramanisteel.com/products/hastelloy/hastelloy-c276/
- UNS: N10276; Werkstoff Nr. 2.4819
- Type: Nickel-molybdenum-chromium alloy
- Density: 8.89 g/cm³
- Standard basis: ASTM B575 / B574
- Minimum properties (Solution annealed): tensile 689 MPa, yield 283 MPa, elongation 40%
- Chemistry limits (weight %): Molybdenum (Mo) 15.0 – 17.0; Chromium (Cr) 14.5 – 16.5; Iron (Fe) 4.0 – 7.0; Tungsten (W) 3.0 – 4.5; Cobalt (Co) 2.5; Manganese (Mn) 1.0; Vanadium (V) 0.35; Silicon (Si) 0.08; Carbon (C) 0.010; Phosphorus (P) 0.04; Sulphur (S) 0.03; Nickel (Ni) Balance
- Applications: Chemical processing; Pollution control; Pulp & paper; Pharmaceutical

## Stainless Steel 303

- Page: https://www.ramanisteel.com/products/stainless-steel/stainless-steel-303/
- UNS: S30300; Werkstoff Nr. 1.4305
- Type: Free-machining austenitic stainless
- Density: 8 g/cm³
- Standard basis: ASTM A582
- Mechanical minimums: not tabulated — Bar standard sets hardness, not tensile minimums
- Chemistry limits (weight %): Carbon (C) 0.15; Manganese (Mn) 2.00; Phosphorus (P) 0.20; Sulphur (S) 0.15 min; Silicon (Si) 1.00; Chromium (Cr) 17.0 – 19.0; Nickel (Ni) 8.0 – 10.0; Iron (Fe) Balance
- Note: Sulphur is a deliberate minimum, not a maximum — it is what makes the grade free-machining.
- Applications: Precision machining; Fasteners; Pumps & valves
